children: NORTHAMPTON, MA / ACCESS Newswire / August 31, 2026 / We're excited to share that, for the first time, Everpure has been named on the 2026 PEOPLE® Companies That Care list!

This recognition reflects our employees' commitment to making a meaningful impact through Pure Good, our social impact program. From employee giving and volunteering to strategic grants supporting communities, the environment, and workforce development, we're proud of how our people bring our values to life.
Thank you to our employees for making this recognition possible-and for continuing to shape what's next.
